newsitem.title: USA: Intel, DEC in settlement talks-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Intel, DEC in settlement talks-WSJ.

text.p: Intel Corp and Digital Equipment Corp are in talks to see if they can settle Digital's patent-infringement lawsuit against Intel, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Friday's electronic edition, the Journal said the talks indicate that Digital may be less interested in punishing Intel than in receiving concessions that would lead to a potential alliance in semiconductor production.
The talks were held in mid-June between Digital Chief Executive Robert Palmer and Intel President Craig Barrett.
Digital's lawsuit accuses Intel of stealing key elements of its patented technology for the design of Pentium processors.

Unnamed sources said Digital is seeking a settlement that would give the computer maker benefits on future Intel chip production. Palmer has raised the possibility of royalties, cross-licensing agreements on a new chip that Intel is developing, or a combination of the two, the Journal said.
